description: Fork of exp154 (BitAttention reference, val_bpb=1.7105). Doubled n_heads 6→12, halved d_qk 32→16 and d_v 32→16. tph values unchanged (qk_tph=384, v_tph=256, out_tph=3056) — total LUT params preserved because H·n_outputs is invariant. Per-head dominance vector P = d_qk·(d_qk-1)/2 = 120 (was 496); BitAttention runs on shorter ±1 vectors. H·d_qk and H·d_v both stay at 192, so out_proj input dim and Q/K total dim unchanged. Tests whether more attention heads with smaller per-head capacity improves over fewer wide heads at the same param budget.
